title: Advanced Web Application Attacks: Beyond OWASP Top 10
description: A deep dive into sophisticated web application attack techniques that go beyond the OWASP Top 10, including advanced client-side attacks, server-side request forgery chains, and novel authentication bypass methods.

title: Securing Microservices: Challenges and Solutions
description: Presented on the unique security challenges posed by microservice architectures and practical solutions for securing service-to-service communication, implementing proper authentication and authorization, and monitoring for security incidents.

title: Building Secure APIs with GraphQL
description: Explored security considerations specific to GraphQL APIs, including query complexity analysis, proper authorization, and preventing information disclosure. Demonstrated practical techniques for securing GraphQL implementations.
